title: Archie #16 Cover B Variant 2017 Cheryl Blossom Marguerite Sauvage Waid Eisma
conditionDescription: Bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Archie #16 (2017), Archie Comics - Cover B variant by Marguerite Sauvage, featuring Cheryl Blossom burning Veronica's photo. Mark Waid story, Joe Eisma art. Cheryl Blossom arrives at Riverdale High. Riverdale (The CW) promo banner. Direct edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: "This is all your fault, Dilton Doiley!" story preview.

Condition: bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
